inputs_used: WebSearch SERP checks 2026-09-25: "Arnav Khandelwal", Arnav Khandelwal MNIT Jaipur, Arnav Khandelwal software engineer backend AI FastAPI, Arrnnnaav github, backend AI engineer portfolio FastAPI local LLM, and one query per flagship project
decisions: Primary entity is Person with @id {SITE_URL}/#person, defined once in content/schema/person.json (replaces the starter organization.json) and referenced by @id everywhere.

Disambiguation is the core strategy: the 'Arnav Khandelwal' SERP is held by namesakes (ZoomInfo x3, 40+ LinkedIn profiles, FIDE). Canonical descriptor 'Arnav Khandelwal, backend and AI engineer, MNIT Jaipur' is used in the home title, Person description, llms.txt and OG image; alumniOf MNIT Jaipur is linked to its Wikipedia page.
sameAs ships with GitHub only (verified). LinkedIn stays TODO: the bare arnav-khandelwal handle is unverified and may belong to a namesake.

Schema plan: layout Person + WebSite; / WebPage + FAQPage; /about ProfilePage + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage; /work CollectionPage + ItemList; /work/[slug] SoftwareSourceCode + Article (author -> #person) + BreadcrumbList (+ optional FAQPage); /contact ContactPage.
FAQ files planned: home.json (5 Qs), about.json (3), contact.json (1), optional work-<slug>.json (1-2 each). Availability answer is blocked until the owner states it.

Crawler policy: keep the starter default (allow GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended; deny CCBot; disallow /styleguide, /e2e-error). No change needed in S4.
Unconfirmed claims are excluded from schema/llms.txt: Dehurdle name (until consent), Cited Researcher 152s->26s ([R only]), BusinessHQ numbers, email, location display.
risks: Name collision: without off-site identity fixes (GitHub bio/blog/location, profile README, LinkedIn website field) the site may not rank for 'Arnav Khandelwal' even with perfect on-page SEO.
GhostCursor collides with the popular ghost-cursor npm/Puppeteer library; titles must lead with 'local AI desktop guide'.
No domain yet: canonical URLs, @ids, sitemap and seo.manifest.json site.url cannot be finalised in S4 without one (a *.vercel.app fallback works but is a weaker entity signal).
No headshot: Person schema ships without image; OG images must be typographic.
SERP shows github.com/Arrnnnaav/smb-safeops and /BuisnessHQ as indexed although CONTENT_SOURCE lists them as private; owner should verify repo visibility.
Only StudyOS is currently found by search/answer engines (via its GitHub repo); AI answers cannot identify the person at all today.
